models_evaluated: eight state-of-the-art LLMs (others not named in abstract)

links.outcome: LLM performance on licensing exam questions, as proxy for clinical competence
links.effect: Five models exceeded the 65% passing threshold with simple prompts; seven did so with few-shot prompts; o1-preview reached 85.5%. Authors note multiple-choice formats cannot address broader clinical competencies.
links.quote: Five models exceeded the 65% passing threshold under simple prompts; seven did so with few-shot prompts.

unlisted_practices: few-shot Chain-of-Thought prompting versus simple prompting to improve LLM exam accuracy

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLMs on family medicine exam questions, comparing simple prompting to few-shot Chain-of-Thought prompt engineering and evaluating hallucination rates.
